cues.zh: 我觉得很多人其实并不清楚自己有多大潜力。
cues.en: I think a lot of people don't actually realize what they're capable of.

cues.zh: 那种会被挑战吸引的人
cues.en: The kind of people who are attracted by challenges

cues.zh: 那种看到困难就全力投入的人——他们不会退缩——
cues.en: The kind of people who see something difficult and go in full force — they don't shy away —

cues.zh: 这种人真的很特别。
cues.en: Those kind of people are really special.

cues.zh: 他们有勇气去迎战任何问题
cues.en: They have this courage to kind of go up against any sort of problem

cues.zh: 在 Nylas 工作最棒的一点是，你可以把全部技能都发挥出来
cues.en: The great thing about working at Nylas is that you can bring all of your skills to the table

cues.zh: 并找到同样注重像素级完美设计的人
cues.en: and find other people with an eye for pixel perfect design and

cues.zh: 以及懂得欣赏极其干净、优美代码的人。
cues.en: an appreciation of really really clean, beautiful code.

cues.zh: 你没法回避一个事实：你不能随便拼凑了事
cues.en: You can't get around the fact that you can't just hack things together

cues.zh: 也不能用胶带打补丁。
cues.en: and patch things with duct tape.

cues.zh: 架构和设计必须有坚实的基础。
cues.en: You have to have a solid foundation for the architecture and design.

cues.zh: 工程中最吸引人的，是把复杂的东西
cues.en: The most compelling thing in engineering is taking something complex

cues.zh: 提供尽可能优雅的接口
cues.en: and providing as elegant an interface as possible

cues.zh: 而底层可能非常复杂
cues.en: to what, under the hood might be really complicated

cues.zh: 我确实认为，人们在 Nylas 有机会去做的事
cues.en: I do think the things that people are getting a chance to work on at Nylas

cues.zh: 人们正在深入钻研的东西，是那种你
cues.en: the things that people are digging their teeth into, are the kind of things you

cues.zh: 在别处根本找不到的。
cues.en: wouldn't be able to get anywhere else.

cues.zh: 我们常开的一个玩笑是：“欢迎加入 Nylas。
cues.en: A recurring joke is, "Welcomed to Nylas.

cues.zh: 这是我们眼下最重要的问题……去搞定它吧。”
cues.en: Here's the most important problem we have right now... go."

cues.zh: 但这其实并不完全是玩笑。
cues.en: Except it's not really a joke.

cues.zh: 关于“为什么以前没人做这个？”这个问题，
cues.en: I think the answer to "Why didn't anyone build this before?"

cues.zh: 我认为答案在于，它其实真的超级难搞。
cues.en: is because it's actually really freaking hard.

cues.zh: 看看我们的团队，以及我们已经做出的成果……
cues.en: If you look at the team we have, and what we've already accomplished...

cues.zh: 这并不取决于大家是否在这类公司积累过丰富的经验。
cues.en: its not predicated on people needing a ton of experience already working at a company.

cues.zh: 真正更重要的是他们的自驱力、雄心，
cues.en: What's really more important is their drive, their ambition

cues.zh: 以及强烈的求知欲。
cues.en: and really their eagerness to learn.

cues.zh: 大家每天来上班有很多原因。
cues.en: There's many reasons that the people come to work every day.

cues.zh: 我们正在构建的产品使命是其中之一……
cues.en: The mission for what we're building is one of them...

cues.zh: 但我认为更强大的动力，是身边的这群同事。
cues.en: but I think the stronger component is the people they're working around.

cues.zh: 以及他们作为工程师、设计师等角色，能在这里如何学习和成长。
cues.en: And how they're able to learn and develop, as engineers or designers or whatever.

cues.zh: 我们能写出更好的软件，是因为公司里的人都很谦逊。
cues.en: We write better software because people at the company are humble.

cues.zh: 这让我们能更好地讨论正在开发的软件，
cues.en: That translates to better conversations about the software getting built,

cues.zh: 也能更好地讨论如何修改软件，以及之后如何重构。
cues.en: and better conversations about changing the software, and refactoring things later.

cues.zh: 前方还有巨大的发展空间和增长潜力……
cues.en: There's just a tremendous scale and growth potential ahead...

cues.zh: 而我们真正需要的，就是更多出色的人才。
cues.en: and really what we need for that, is just more exceptional people.
